description.zh:
播流域名。支持单个或批量域名查询。批量查询时多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。
若参数为空，默认返回所有直播域名合并后的数据。
description.en:
The streaming domain. You can specify a single domain name or multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).
If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all live streaming domains is returned by default.

description.zh: 结束时间。结束时间需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

description.zh:
查询数据的时间粒度。单位：秒。取值：
- **300**（默认值）
- **3600**
- **86400**

> - 不传或传值不支持时，取默认值**300**。
- 查询时间粒度为**300**时，返回的bps数据值为300秒内平均每秒传输的bit。
- 查询时间粒度为**3600**和**86400**时，返回的bps数据值为查询时间内所有300秒取值点的峰值。
description.en:
The time granularity of the queried data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:
- **300** (default)
- **3600**
- **86400**

> - If this parameter is not specified or set to an unsupported value, the default value **300** is used.
- When the time granularity is **300**, the returned bps value is the average number of bits transmitted per second within the 300-second interval.
- When the time granularity is **3600** or **86400**, the returned bps value is the peak value among all 300-second data points within the query period.

description.zh: 运营商英文名。通过[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~)接口获得。
description.en: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP) in English. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to obtain the ISP name.
The name of the region in English. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to obtain the region name.
The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

title.zh: 查询域名网络带宽监控数据
title.en: Query network bandwidth monitoring data of a domain name

descriptions.zh:
- 不指定StartTime和EndTime时，默认读取过去24小时的数据，同时支持按指定的起止时间查询，两者需要同时指定。
- 仅指定StartTime，未指定EndTime时，读取从StartTime开始1小时之内的数据。
- 仅指定EndTime，未指定StartTime时，读取从EndTime向前1小时之内的数据。
- 支持最长可查询最近90天的数据。
- 本接口为监控数据接口，数据采集处理方式不同于计费，不能用于计算用量进行对账参考。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- If you do not specify StartTime or EndTime, data of the last 24 hours is returned by default. You can also query data for a specific time range by specifying both StartTime and EndTime.
- If you specify only StartTime without EndTime, data within 1 hour from StartTime is returned.
- If you specify only EndTime without StartTime, data within 1 hour before EndTime is returned.
- You can query data of up to the last 90 days.
- This is a monitoring data API. The data collection and processing method differs from that used for billing. Do not use this API to calculate usage for billing reconciliation.

## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this API is 100 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, the API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this API at a reasonable frequency.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-domain-bps-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T09:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en alibaba --location-name-en tianjin --region cn-hangzhou
